description:
Use this when you need a deterministic baseline offset for a federally regulated-employer calendar in 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a provincial, private-employer or schedule-specific substitution result.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using Canada federal general holidays and a Saturday/Sunday baseline; schedule-dependent substitute days remain unresolved.
Example user requests: Add five Canada federal working days after 2026-09-28.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-09-29","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, federal_general_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_actual_dates, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when Canada federal status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/canada-federal-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/canada-federal-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_canada_federal_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or Canada federal general holiday.

holiday_names.description: Canada Labour Code general holidays applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: False because substitute dates depend on schedule and agreement and are not inferred.

rest_day_policy.description: Scheduled-workday and employer substitution rules are not inferred.

sources.description: Official Canada.ca and Canada Labour Code sources.

substitute_day_policy.description: Canada.ca rule summary with schedule-dependent boundary.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Canada Federal Working Days
